title: Empty State CTA
requirements: Replace the passive "No entries yet. Click 'New Entry'…" text in EmptyState with a centered, prominent CTA Button labeled "New Entry"
The CTA button calls the same startRecording() action as the toolbar New Entry primary action — single source of truth for the action
Keep the CTA centered vertically and horizontally in the empty-list area; use prominent styling (buttonStyle(.borderedProminent) or equivalent)
First-launch users see the CTA without scanning the toolbar — the toolbar button remains for subsequent entries
acceptance_criteria: From a fresh installation, a user can start their first recording with one click of the centered CTA
The CTA and the toolbar button trigger the identical startRecording() action
The CTA is visually prominent (not a plain text link)
